Home.installNote: That's it — the widget lazy-loads itself and auto-resizes to fit its content.

features.title: Drop-in embed
features.desc: One <div> and one <script> tag. Works on any HTML page — no framework required on your side.

features.title: Sandboxed & safe
features.desc: Runs inside a sandboxed iframe with origin-checked messaging, so it never touches your page's DOM directly.

features.title: Firebase-powered
features.desc: Anonymous auth for commenters, Google sign-in for site owners, Firestore for storage — no backend to run yourself.

features.title: Built-in moderation
features.desc: Approve, mark as spam, or delete comments per site from a simple dashboard.

features.title: Bilingual by default
features.desc: The dashboard site and docs ship in English and Indonesian, so you and your visitors can read them comfortably.

features.title: Fast & SEO-friendly
features.desc: Lazy-loaded, cached, and built on Next.js with proper metadata, sitemaps, and structured data out of the box.

faq.q: Do I need to install any npm package?
faq.a: No. The widget runs as an already-hosted service — you just paste the HTML/JS snippet above into your page.

faq.q: Do visitors need an account to comment?
faq.a: No. Visitors comment anonymously by default; they are never asked to create an account.

faq.q: Can I use it on multiple domains?
faq.a: Yes. Register each domain from the dashboard so every site gets its own settings and moderation queue.
